subject: Compliance questionnaire and evidence intake: ISO & FedRAMP alignment
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura@borealisbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@averysolutions.com
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial intake: SIG/CAIQ + ISO/FedRAMP alignment questions

Jonas / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, Borealis is starting a rigorous intake for vendors that need to demonstrate alignment with our ISO 27001 controls and FedRAMP-relevant evidence. Attached is our standard SIG/CAIQ baseline worksheet and a short intake checklist (SIG-CAIQ-request-template.xlsx).

Quick asks to help us scope the work and set a mutual action plan:
- Can you confirm which ISO 27001 standard you map to (2013 vs 2022) and whether you have a current certificate or a planned audit window?
- Are you tracking FedRAMP readiness (e.g., moderate/low baseline)? If so, what elements of your architecture/policy would you expect to fall into scope (encryption-at-rest, KMS, dedicated VPC, logging retention window)?
- Do you have an available SOC 2 report and a control mapping (SOC2->SIG/CAIQ) we can review?

Target timeline from our side: evidence intake window 06/22–07/02. Can Redwood provide a slim intake package by 06/19 (SOC 2 report + top-line control crosswalk + indicative artifact list)? We can then schedule a short intake call with our GRC team on 06/23 if needed.

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-request-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence_manifest_request.txt

Thanks,
Laura Jensen
Senior Third-Party Risk Manager
Borealis Bank
laura@borealisbank.com

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura@borealisbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial intake: SIG/CAIQ + ISO/FedRAMP alignment questions

Laura — thanks for the clear asks and the template, very helpful.

High level response and proposed next steps:
1) ISO posture: Redwood currently maintains an ISO 27001:2013 certification in scope for our hosted inference control plane. We are tracking an upgrade path for alignment with the 2022 revisions and can surface a roadmap and planned audit windows by EOD Friday. (Action: Karthik to confirm exact dates and scope.)

2) FedRAMP readiness: we do not currently hold a FedRAMP authorization but have a documented FedRAMP-mapping effort targeting the Moderate baseline for customers that require it. Primary in-scope items for the hosted offering are: encryption-at-rest (KMS-backed), customer-configurable VPC peering for Private deployments, centralized logging (30/90 day retention options), and support for evidence snapshots for auditing. (Action: Marissa to confirm encryption/KMS artifacts and retention SLAs.)

3) SOC 2: we have a recent SOC 2 Type II attestation (period ending 2025-10). I will pull the attestation and a high-level control crosswalk (SOC2->SIG/CAIQ) and share as a protected link.

Proposed schedule:
- 06/16: Redwood provides SOC 2 attestation link + control crosswalk + short list of artifacts we can commit to in the 06/22–07/02 intake window.
- 06/19: internal review by Borealis; confirm intake call on 06/23 if deeper Q&A needed.

Marissa / Karthik / Grace — can you each confirm owners for the artifact buckets below and whether we can assemble the initial package by 06/16?
- Policy & governance artifacts (ISO cert, statements): Grace
- Technical artifacts (KMS config, key rotation policy, encryption diagrams): Marissa
- FedRAMP mapping & scope (network boundary, logging retention): Karthik

Laura — happy to jump on the 06/23 intake call; let me know a time window and we’ll block.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

Jonas — assigning owners and confirming artifacts. Forwarding the intake request to our evidence intake queue and starting a slim evidence bundle. See list below (I will upload links to the shared drive):

Planned deliverables for 06/16:
- SOC2-2025-attestation.pdf (attestation link will be DM-protected)
- control_crosswalk_SOC2_to_SIG.xlsx
- kms_key_management_policy.pdf (key rotation cadence and KMS provider details)

Notes:

- If Borealis requires sampled snapshots (logs, config state), we can produce redacted samples — please confirm the exact timeframe (e.g., 30-day snapshot) and whether they need remote verification by auditors.

Attachments: [attachment: kms_key_management_policy.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: control_crosswalk_SOC2_to_SIG.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Jonas / Marissa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the list of deliverables. A few follow-ups from the GRC intake team: 

- For ISO, confirmation of certificate scope is important — we need to verify whether the ISO certificate covers the hosted inference runtime and any managed services used to process customer data. A scan of the encryption_architecture_v2.pdf should help.
- For sampled snapshots: we would like a 30-day log snapshot and a configuration snapshot for a single tenant environment (redacted where needed) as part of the audit dry-run. Can Redwood confirm if redacted samples are acceptable and provide a timeline for producing them within the intake window?
- Regarding the SOC2 attestation, please provide a secure link (DocuSign or Drive link with access controls). We will not accept attachments via unprotected email.

If you can confirm the above and post the initial bundle by COB 06/16 (or share protected links), we will proceed with the intake review and confirm whether the intake call on 06/23 is required.

Best regards,
Laura Jensen
